The '''Rapid Response Team''' was a unit of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Senate Planetary Intelligence Network]] (SPIN). Composed of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], the unit was to be used for secret operations. However, as all the members of the group were well known, the team was not as effective as had been planned. SPIN was later disbanded and its resources taken over by the [[New Republic Intelligence Service]].<ref name="SPINblog" />
